reviews.decision: Tooltip Escape dismissal retains the historical Escape/no-modifier predicate. Exact import ESCAPE at line 18 resolves to the inspected binding; its uses are line 471 keycode-comparison. The imported constant is exactly 27 in the original public runtime and both minimum public declarations/runtimes. Original16.2.14 and actual CDK minima22.1.7/21.2.14 are independently archive-authenticated; the export is public and has no deprecation/private marker. The complete finite source/value receipts and 24 rejected semantic/provenance/binding mutations support this dependency boundary. Component keyboard routing, DI/lifetime, a11y/native/AOT/packed/runtime-floor and upstream SHA decisions remain separate audit obligations. Subsequent exact-source re-review: only empty class @Directive metadata changed to explicit standalone:false, restoring the Material16 setting; this import and all its referenced bodies/types are byte-identical. Prior diagnostic runs remain historical. Hashed metadata delta supports current source binding; native compiler/inheritance/module/rendering/floor qualification is still open. Tooltip render follow-up rechecked this exact binding at the changed source. Its existing public/source contract is unchanged; the private microtask wait repair and genuine public hooks are separately documented, with actual legacy/native qualification still pending. Tooltip ARIA follow-up rechecked the exact import/reference context after a private destruction guard. The public declaration and constructor contract remain unchanged; source lifecycle diagnostics are separate from actual native/packed qualification. The one independently qualified clipping callback/predicate repair now uses public pane/ancestor DOMRects before position-class changes. All imports/exported signatures,hide/class methods and33 resources remain unchanged. This current binding retains the original role conclusion and complete prior case,with fresh checker-bound uses and current class contexts; no whole directive,native,packed/AOT or floor pass is inferred. Current source adds the public CDK event predicate; current Material 22.1.7 independently uses the same predicate. Tagged Material 16/CDK top-overlay dispatch differs for unrelated and modified keys, so this is a qualified named-use source decision with a recorded compatibility change, not behavioral identity. Focus, key and pointer evidence and the exact source/test scope are recorded in the separate proof; motion and release remain held.
